questions.explanation: Use the possessive adjective 'my' before a noun with I.
questions.q: I have a dog. ___ name is Max.

questions.explanation: Use the possessive adjective 'her' before a noun with she.
questions.q: She has a car. ___ car is red.

questions.explanation: Use the possessive adjective 'his' before a noun with he.
questions.q: He has a bike. ___ bike is new.

questions.explanation: Use the possessive adjective 'our' before a noun with we.
questions.q: We have a house. ___ house is big.

questions.explanation: Use the possessive adjective 'your' before a noun with you.
questions.q: You have a pen. ___ pen is blue.

questions.explanation: Use the possessive adjective 'their' before a noun with they.
questions.q: They have a cat. ___ cat is white.

questions.explanation: Use 'her' before a noun to show that a girl owns it.
questions.q: The girl has a doll. ___ doll is pretty.

questions.explanation: Use 'our' before a noun to show that we own it.
questions.q: John and I have a room. ___ room is small.
